messages:
Alex Chen: Ran into flakiness on PR #4823 -- quant-smoke CI passes on nightly but PR GHA fails with "cache-mismatch" when Buildkite artifacts are missing.
Priya Rao: seen this. logs show runner reconnects mid-upload? :thinking:
Devon Kim: which job? the quant smoke or the full eval matrix?
Alex Chen: quant-smoke specifically. GH Actions job uploads shard artifact, then self-hosted runner times out and GC removes temp artifacts on disk. ci-bot: upload failed: 504 gateway timeout (attempt 3) -> requeued.
Maria Lopez: oh the selfhosted heartbeat bug again? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/3412
Alex Chen: yep looks related. Nightly uses dedicated Buildkite pool with warm cache so it's fine. PRs hit GHA runners which are more prone to short-lived disconnects.
Priya Rao: proposal: keep PRs fast by gating only lightweight evals, and offload heavy quant/shard runs to Buildkite or nightly. Add label `run-eval` to opt into heavy tests.
Devon Kim: agreed. also add cache validation step so we fail early if artifact missing instead of proceeding.
Alex Chen: draft GHA condition I tested:
```
if: github.event.pull_request && contains(join(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, ','), 'run-eval')
```
Devon Kim: can we use `paths-ignore` too to avoid unrelated PR noise?
Maria Lopez: yep. and for Buildkite, use concurrency_key to avoid thundering herd on artifact uploads:
```
steps:
  - command: ./scripts/run_quant_smoke.sh --shard $BUILDKITE_PARALLEL_JOB
    concurrency_key: "eval-${BUILDKITE_PULL_REQUEST}"
    agents: ["queue=eval"]
```
Priya Rao: also add a short `artifact-healthcheck` job before heavy steps that checks manifest + checksum.
Alex Chen: good. I'll open PR with three changes: 1) GHA conditional label check, 2) artifact-healthcheck job + clearer failures, 3) docs to ask SEs to add `run-eval` label for heavy runs. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/1287
ci-bot: Alex Chen opened PR #1287 with updates to .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml :bell:
Devon Kim: can we also add metric for "eval_pr_requeue_rate" in datadog? want to track requeues by runner type.
Maria Lopez: yes add gauge and tag by `runner:gha` / `runner:buildkite`.
Alex Chen: will add metrics + dashboard tile to the evals dashboard. low priority but helpful to spot regressions after infra fixes. :shipit:
Priya Rao: for immediate unblock, i'll temporarily flip PR gating to skip heavy steps unless `run-eval` present.
Devon Kim: thanks. follow-up: create infra issue to fix heartbeat GC on GHA self-hosted runners.
Alex Chen: filed infra issue #3421 for runner GC, cc @infra-team
Maria Lopez: awesome. thanks everyone :tada:
